description: Projecting an \(A\)-definable set of finite tuples onto any finite list of coordinates gives an \(A\)-definable set.
signature:
Set.Definable.image_comp.{u, v, w, u₁, u_1} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u_1} {s : Set (β → M)} (h : A.Definable L s) (f : α → β) [Finite α] [Finite β] :
  A.Definable L ((fun g => g ∘ f) '' s)
